about_the_game:
LUMARA

THE LIGHT FADES. THE ABYSS AWAITS.

Descend into the depths of a dying ocean where the last remnants of light battle against an encroaching darkness. As a mutated anglerfish guided by ancient relics and gifts left by the Guardians of the Deep, you alone can restore life to these corrupted waters—or witness their final descent into oblivion.

ILLUMINATE THE UNKNOWN

Navigate through haunting underwater landscapes where bioluminescence is both your weapon and salvation. Toggle your light to reveal hidden paths, solve intricate puzzles, and evade predators lurking in the darkness. But beware—sometimes, staying in shadow is the only way to survive.

DISCOVER ANCIENT POWERS

Uncover sacred relics and mutation stones left by the Guardians of the Deep. Activate the Stone of Growth to move heavy obstacles, use the Stone of Smallness to access forgotten passages, or wield the Stone of Invisibility to escape detection. Master these gifts to overcome increasingly complex challenges as you venture deeper into the abyss.

CLEANSE THE CORRUPTION

The ocean is dying, poisoned by mankind's waste and strange, otherworldly forces. Absorb toxins, clear debris, and restore life to this once-vibrant ecosystem. Every area you heal brings new creatures, colors, and hope to a world on the brink of extinction.

A STORY TOLD IN SILENCE

No words are needed to understand the devastation that surrounds you. Through environmental storytelling, thought bubbles, and encounters with the mysterious Guardian of the Deep, unravel the tragedy that befell these waters—and perhaps discover your own origin.

FEATURES:

  • STRIKING MINIMALIST AESTHETIC - Experience a handcrafted visual style, where silhouettes and selective coloring create an atmosphere both beautiful and terrifying.

  • INNOVATIVE LIGHT MECHANICS - Use your bioluminescence to interact with the environment in unique ways, changing colors to affect different obstacles and creatures.

  • PHYSICS-BASED PUZZLES - Navigate a world where currents, pressure, and weight matter. Move objects, create paths, and manipulate your surroundings to progress.

  • ATMOSPHERIC SOUND DESIGN - Immerse yourself in a dynamic soundscape that reacts to your actions and the environment, enhancing the feeling of isolation and wonder.

  • ENVIRONMENTAL STORYTELLING - Piece together the history of this ruined world through visual cues, artifacts, and subtle details in the environment.

  • MULTIPLE DIFFICULTY OPTIONS - Choose your challenge: from an exploration-focused journey with unlimited lives to a hardcore permadeath experience for those seeking the ultimate test.

In Lumara, light is life, darkness is mystery, and the ocean holds secrets waiting to be discovered. Will you be its savior, or merely witness its final breath?

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 240 GT or Radeon HD 6570 – 1024 MB (1 gig)

short_description: Navigate the ruins of a dying ocean, solve physics-based puzzles, and evade deep-sea horrors as you fight to restore what was lost. Descend into the abyss in this atmospheric 2D puzzle-adventure, where you are the last light in a world choked by shadows and corruption.
